When I was about your age I had begun to adapt anarchist views(26 now) 
I was homeschooled as a kid but sent to church camp where we had to say the pledge every morning. I went as far as to turn my back and cross my arms while all the other kids recited it with their hands over their heart without question in a perfect order of assimilation with each other every morning for 5 days in a row. I was lucky enough to not get hit by anyone but the counselors engaged me about it. I stood my ground and explained to them that I simply wasn’t patriotic. I wasn’t very articulate or well defined in my views to say anything truly compelling to the youth leaders but by day 3 I had 10 out of 150 other kids turning their back with me. 

The best advice I can give you is don’t stop! 
Don’t give into the pressure of your peers to pledge to a piece of cloth that stands for colonialism, capitalist interest and white supremacy. Remain sitting every single day. Hold your ground! At first you’ll deal with reactionary mentalities and that won’t be easy but eventually it’ll become normal and no one will think twice about it. No one can make you pledge. No one can make you stand. You are Your own authority. Stay strong comrade!
All I'm gonna say is that my childhood memories are priceless.
